invoicingPeriodPresent.description: Whether a document-level invoicing period (BG-14) is used; independent of its dates (BR-CO-19).
invoicingPeriodPresent.title: Invoicing Period Present

periodPresent.description: Whether the invoice line period (BG-26) is used (BR-CO-20).
periodPresent.title: Period Present

invoiceLines.title: Invoice Lines
invoiceLines.description: A list of invoice lines entries.

IossImport.title: IOSS Import Consignment
IossImport.description: An import consignment declared under the Import One-Stop-Shop (IOSS): intrinsic value up to EUR 150, every line VAT-charged (the <=EUR 22 exemption is abolished).

consignmentValue.description: Intrinsic value of the consignment (excl. transport/insurance), <= EUR 150.
consignmentValue.title: Consignment Value

vatAmount.description: VAT charged on the consignment (must be > 0).
vatAmount.title: VAT Amount

vatRate.description: VAT rate of the Member State of consumption.
vatRate.title: VAT Rate

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a IOSS Import Consignment is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

TravelAgentMargin.title: Travel-Agent Margin (art. 306)
TravelAgentMargin.description: A supply under the special margin scheme for travel agents (VAT Directive art. 306): taxable amount = the agent's margin (selling - cost), with no input-VAT deduction on the bought-in travel supplies.

sellingPrice.description: Total amount charged to the traveller (excl. VAT).
sellingPrice.title: Selling Price

cost.description: Cost of the bought-in travel supplies.
cost.title: Cost

inputVatDeducted.description: Whether input VAT on the supplies was deducted (must be false under the scheme).
inputVatDeducted.title: Input VAT Deducted

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Travel-Agent Margin (art. 306) is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
